mentions.name: Clawrium
mentions.description: This CLI orchestrates a fleet of autonomous agents on multiple physical hosts, centralizing configuration management, secrets, templates, and LLM providers in a kubectl-like control plane.
mentions.problem: Running agents on a home network required SSHing into each host to maintain them; Clawrium centralizes their management instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Clawrium (https://github.com/ric03uec/clawrium), a CLI to orchestrate a fleet of autonomous agents(like openclaw, hermes etc) on multiple physical hosts.
